# Ujan Homestay

> A private, family-run homestay in Hatigaon, Guwahati, Assam, India. Tagline: "Feel at home, away from home."

- Address: House No. 38, Mother Teresa Path, Opposite Hatigaon Police Station, Hatigaon, Guwahati, Assam 781038
- Rates: from ₹1,500 per night; the exact rate depends on dates and room and is confirmed on WhatsApp
- Booking: WhatsApp +91 98649 16371 · Call +91 98649 16371 or +91 88766 33455
- Amenities: air-conditioned rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, easy parking, kitchen access, clean and hygienic rooms, no sharing with strangers
- Suitable for: couples, families and business travellers
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ujanhomestay/
